name: EPIC 247604142
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 18.8 solar radii and 1.81 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 5,162 parsecs away, 19 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.81 solar masses and 18.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,696 K at its surface.
